notes: Sorphera Sepolia application contracts. Sales are disabled and dependencies/settings are unset. Public FWA Sepolia pool read at block 11866914 predates builder attribution; do not activate against it. Configure a separately verified compatible FWA pool/helper and an operator-owned, funded lottery VRF subscription through the documented setters. No wallet keys or broadcasts are used. Immutable per-round purchaser vaults are created at runtime by SorpheraVaultFactory; their addresses and creation blocks are emitted, not guessed. After deployment the owner binds the factory to the deployed Sorphera address once with setLottery; only that lottery can create vaults.
